environment.note: Additive, migration-free correctness fix to hosted_workspace/monitoring_reconcile.py (ADR-0125), closing filed backlog item (b) in docs/NEXT.md. DEFECT: reconcile_account failed closed to a baseline rollback whenever a post-apply attestation did not verify, INCLUDING when the signed env was NEVER dispatched (apply_ok=False -- the host-gated DORMANT path where the signed executor is unavailable and the real adapter _RealMonitoringOps.apply_off_env returns (False, None, 'host_executor_unavailable') BEFORE touching the host). It then dispatched a second doomed baseline 'rollback' and reported rollback_reason='rollback_failed' -- fabricating the failure of an undo for a reconcile that mutated nothing (a false operator alarm implying a dirty tenant bridge on every dormant-host --commit), and a transient host recovery between the two doomed calls could have mis-counted rolled_back for a never-applied account. FIX: split the failure path on apply_ok (the transport's 'did I dispatch' signal). apply_ok=False => truthful ok=False, applied=False, rolled_back=False, rollback_reason=None, reason='apply_not_dispatched:<r>', NO rollback attempted. apply_ok=True + unverified attestation => the EXISTING fail-closed rollback with a genuine rollback_failed preserved. The read-back-failure rollback branch is UNCHANGED (only reached after a verified apply, so its rollback is genuine). The MonitoringReconcileOps.apply_off_env adapter contract is documented: ok=False MUST mean never-dispatched (bridge byte-unchanged); an adapter that has begun mutating must never return ok=False. Monitoring-only, execution-OFF: no execution/arm/order/MT5_ALLOW_LIVE, no gate/identity-pin/env-delta/TOCTOU change, no migration, no flag, no schema/DB change, no broker/MT5/host contact, no cross-tenant data flow. No public result key changed; the only consumer (reconcile_monitoring_readonly_positions management command) reads only summary.applied/refused/total. Base is current main 795aa3a2 (expected base de98027f advanced during the packet by the disjoint docs-only #691 GFX-167 runbook pin -- docs/STATUS.md + docs/COPIER_46_48_DEMO_RUNBOOK.md, zero overlap with the 2 changed files; rebased onto 795aa3a2).
